paragraphs: The morning begins with drawings, sensor installation, and wiring. Midday brings wind-tunnel or test-stand runs and data collection. The afternoon is spent investigating abnormalities, disassembling parts, measuring tolerances, and reworking components. Before leaving, update equipment records and reports; spare time goes to studying standards for new aircraft.
